test_title: PYST 50: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 04 Nov, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Industrialisation gives even the least talented person a chance to ____________ his livelihood.
solution:
The correct answer is '**earn**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "**earn his livelihood**" is a standard and correct expression that means to make a living or to support oneself financially.
 
• The verb "**earn**" appropriately fits the context of receiving income or sustenance through work or industrial opportunities.
 
• Other verbs such as "**live**", "**give**", or "**break**" do not logically or grammatically fit in this phrase.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Industrialisation gives even the least talented person a chance to **earn**__ his livelihood.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Live**: means to be alive or exist; it does not fit the expression "live his livelihood."
 
• **Give**: means to provide something to someone; incorrect in the context of earning a living.
 
• **Break**: generally refers to separating or damaging; it is not associated with livelihood or income.
